Hi Evelyn — thanks for the note and the schedule. Short answers up front:

- To have credits applied against the Nov invoice, we need the formal PO + supporting credit mapping by COB Nov 24 (PST). Anything after that will likely fall into the Dec cycle and trigger refund/adjustment workflows.
- For partner pass-throughs, include the partner contract code P-AP-4187 in the PO line description and set the accounting reference to AWSPP-2027-RED. Our ops team needs both strings to map correctly.

I’m attaching the AWS_Credit_Tracker_Q4_2027.csv with the credit IDs I see on our side — please confirm the IDs match your schedule. Also, we’ll need CloudBridge’s signed SOW and an invoice that breaks out the marketplace fee line so we can route the credit before payment.

I’ve cc’d aws-partner-ops; they’ll confirm once they receive PO and SOW and can advise on final timing. Two-week processing window is typical once we have everything in the system, so the Nov 24 deadline is firm to hit Nov invoice.

Let me know if you want to jump on a short call today to walk through the IDs.

Best,
Sandra Mills
Sr. Partner Manager — AWS Marketplace
